contour_scope: projected minimum-Z convex hull; visually reviewed as approximately octagonal; installation seam requires exact loop reconstruction
cover_thickness_validation: layout placeholder, not a structural or pressure-vessel specification
physical_conversion: position_m = s * position_source; cover_thickness_source = 0.005 / s; s is not selected
port_frame_convention: +Z outward (-Z_source), +X = +X_source, +Y = -Y_source; origin is the study installation plane, not the vendor mating datum
port_type: RAFTI Rev A passive fill/drain and refueling interface; service-side active coupling remains separate
storage: independent tank geometry and mass model required; shell cavity volume is not tank capacity
